title: M3E game fixture (m3e-game-fixture, version 1)
description: One known state of a game, written by its game loop for M3E to show: the world's snapshot as its view() gives it, and what each of the contract's commands sent as calls answers in that state (the low-frequency state: the gems left, what a summon gives, a check-in that is cooling down). Written against one gameplay contract (m3e-game), named by its namespace and version. M3E reads it and never writes it (docs/玩法契约.md, “fixture”).

namespace.description: The namespace of the gameplay contract it was written against: game.

contractVersion.description: The version of that contract (its contractVersion): a fixture of another version is still read, and the difference said.

id.description: What names it among the game loop's fixtures: low-gems, day-12. Importing one of the same id again replaces it.

snapshot.description: The world's snapshot in this state, as the contract's snapshot schema says it.

answers.description: By command (one the contract sends as a call): what it answers in this state, its result or one of its rejections. A command left out is answered as the mock library makes its answers.

result.description: What the command answers, as the contract's result schema says it.

rejection.description: The code it refuses with: one of the command's rejections.

detail.description: With a rejection: the problem's detail, in the game loop's words.
